feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 July 2026 9:57pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 17 July 2026 at 9:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasional strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the south of Iceland, with a ridge covering the British Isles.


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less in places throughout, otherwise mainly North or Northwest 3 to 5, increasing 4 or 5 occasionally 6 in the west of the area for a time tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate in the west of the area overnight, then slight occasionally moderate in all waters later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 3 to 5, but Variable 3 or less in places, becoming North or Northwest 4 or 5 in all waters later.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate, falling smooth or slight overnight into Sunday, then becoming slight occasionally moderate again later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
